methodology: Institution names are only the exact text before the first comma in the published institution cell, normalized for case, accents, whitespace and punctuation. No abbreviation expansion, token similarity, substring, city inference or fuzzy matching is used.
Name matching requires an explicit state on both sides and exactly one historical identity and one current identity sharing that name/state key. Unknown states never pass this method.
Generic names such as Government Medical College, District Hospital and ESI Hospital do not qualify for name-only matching, even if a dataset happens to contain one such institution in a state.
Name/state matches with conflicting explicit six-digit postal codes are withheld. Missing postal codes are not guessed.
Unique complete institution/address matches preserve stronger evidence; explicit state conflicts are rejected. Current source aliases are used only for complete-address matching.
Final matches are one historical identity to one current MCC-coded identity. Competing historical identities remain unmatched unless one has a unique complete-address match.
Parenthesized six-digit address values are not treated as MCC institute codes without explicit source identification. No historical institution had an explicit MCC-code field.
